Boundary fact for R1: today the authoritative state lives on three.js objects, so the port must lift it out of the scene graph. Soldier positions are scene-node positions moved in place (player.position and en.group.position, by resolveObstacles and tickVertical at game:2780 and :2933). The player's facing is the group's rotation.y, set from the cursor's aim point (game:2710) and read by the Riot Shield block (game:1514) and playerFireOrigin (game:1420). A grenade's position is its mesh's position (game:2857). A crate's orientation is its mesh's rotation.y (game:1452, :2526). Crate, building and house colliders are THREE.Box3 objects filled from meshes (Box3.setFromObject at game:85 and :506, core:1044; _bkWorldBoxes through matrixWorld, core:1430).
